title: Weak rains clouds recovery in Rs 3.3 lakh crore microfinance sector
summary: India's microfinance sector, with a market worth ₹3.30 lakh crore, is encountering credit risk hurdles. Key factors include inconsistent rainfall and drought in critical states such as Karnataka and Maharashtra, which deeply influence the agricultural economy tied to rural borrowers. In response, some institutions are exercising caution by closely monitoring high-risk areas, yet the lack of loan protection further exacerbates the financial risks involved.

title: Vedanta announces Rs 5 per share dividend, sets October 14 as record date
summary: Vedanta has announced a dividend of ₹5 per share for the current fiscal, which will amount to a total payout of ₹1,955 crore from the company. Record date for the dividend is October 14. title: Jane Street hits back at Sebi’s allegations, says ‘regulator changed the goal posts’

title: Anup Bagchi set to become India's highest-paid bank CEO, may earn Rs 35.9 crore a year
summary: HDFC Bank has proposed a substantial annual remuneration package of ₹35.9 crore for Anup Bagchi, subject to shareholder approval. This package would include a fixed pay component and performance-linked variable compensation, along with a one-time joining bonus. Bagchi’s proposed compensation significantly exceeds that of outgoing CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan and other banking peers. The company's shareholders will vote on this proposal through a postal ballot until November 6.

title: JM Financial tops investment banking league table in H1 FY27
summary: Domestic investment banks experienced significant success in achieving equity fundraising in HY27. The equity amount raised rose by 40%, reaching nearly Rs 1.7 lakh crore. This surge in activity reflects a healthy trend in the domestic investment banking sector.

title: GQG Partners sells Rs 24,400 cr worth of Indian stocks in 2026; ITC, Adani shares among key exits
summary: GQG Partners has recently executed a block deal, offloading ITC shares worth approximately ₹9,395 crore. The firm has also downplayed its presence in several Adani Group enterprises this year, while simultaneously ramping up investments in JSW Energy and JSW Steel during the June quarter. In total, GQG has scaled back investments worth around ₹24,400 crore across various Indian firms since early 2026, continuing to oversee assets exceeding $156 billion.

title: At Rs 35.9 crore, HDFC Bank's incoming boss Anup Bagchi set to be India's highest-paid bank CEO
